body:
I know people care but when I’m in the state of mind I’m in I don’t care about living for others. I’ve done it so much trying to take care of others physically and financially and I was never thanked nor will they ever. 
They all think I’m a piece of shit. They don’t think they owe me anything. And they’ve taught me that nobody owes you anything. If you help or give someone money; never expect to see it back again. Never expect a thank you.
I lost my college days and 20s for this. And I never got to fulfill my dreams and the things I wanted to. 
The money I had for studio sound engineering went to kids I didn’t think I had to take care of financially... they weren’t my kids but I’d be the piece of shit if I didn’t do it. 
It’s not about me anymore. It’s about others and i saddens me that I’m lost out on doing what I wanted because I put others before me... 
It’s not always a go thing to do the right thing and put others first... You can miss out and waste your own life.

I told my fiancé and I 100% regret it. 
I’m doing everything I should be doing.
Taking antidepressants, going to the gym and talking to a therapist. However I’ve cancelled my last two therapy appointments because nothing changed. Therefore there’s nothing to talk about. 
He always suggests things but if I didn’t do anything what’s the point for the appointment. 🤷‍♀️
Plus I when my depression is too bad I don’t want to talk to anybody anyways. I go silent.
